technical_quality: Adequate: PA projection, full inspiration (about 9-10 posterior ribs), minimal rotation, adequate penetration; scapulae partly overlap the lateral upper lung fields. L side marker present at the image upper-right corner.

devices.type: L side marker with lead ID tag (external film marker, not a patient device)
devices.location: image upper-right corner, over the patient's left shoulder region

abnormalities.finding: Patchy ill-defined airspace opacity adjacent to the left heart border (lingula / medial left lower zone), with partial obscuration of the lower left heart border (silhouette sign); dominant component of the labelled consolidation, ~6 cm

Hazy patchy opacity along the right heart border in the medial right lower zone (paracardiac / right middle lobe-medial lower lobe region), ~5 cm, with a small ring-like lucency near the right cardiophrenic angle
Prominent, rounded / unfolded aortic knob (tortuous thoracic aorta)
Prominent bilateral hila with coarse peribronchovascular markings (chronic bronchitic / bronchiectatic pattern)
No pleural effusion or pneumothorax; costophrenic angles sharp bilaterally; gastric fundal air bubble under left hemidiaphragm (normal)

description_zh: PA 胸部正面片。心影明顯擴大（心胸比約 0.6），主動脈弓突出且迂曲。雙側下肺野可見邊界不清之斑片狀浸潤影，以左側心緣旁（舌葉／左下肺內側）較為明顯，約 6 cm，並使左心緣下段部分模糊；右側心緣旁內側下肺野亦有約 5 cm 之淡薄斑片影，並於右肋膈角附近見小環狀透亮影。雙側肺門突出、支氣管血管紋理粗糙增多；兩側肋膈角銳利，未見肋膜積液或氣胸，未見任何管路、引流或植入裝置，僅見影像右上角之 L 側別標記。
